# MS Auto Care (Madhu Sujatha) — Car Mechanic & Water Wash Srikalahasti

> Premier car repairs, auto repairs, computerized engine diagnostics, and 100% scratch-free snow foam wash center in Panagal, Srikalahasti, Andhra Pradesh. We wash and service ALL vehicles without exception — including bikes, auto rickshaws, cars, SUVs, farm tractors, heavy trucks, lorries, and JCB earthmovers.

## Fleet & Vehicle Acceptance Matrix
- **Two-Wheelers:** Bikes, Scooters, Bullet motorcycles, Cruisers, Superbikes (From ₹100)
- **Three-Wheelers:** Auto Rickshaws, Passenger Autos, Cargo Piaggio Ape (From ₹200)
- **Four-Wheelers:** Hatchbacks (₹350), Sedans (₹450), Compact SUVs (₹500), Full-size SUVs & MUVs (₹600)
- **Commercial Pickups & Vans:** Tata Ace, Bolero Pickup, Eeco, Omni (From ₹450)
- **Agricultural Equipment:** Farm Tractors, Tillers, Harvesters (From ₹600)
- **Heavy Industrial Equipment:** JCB Earthmovers, Tipper Trucks, Lorries, Freight Carriers, Buses (From ₹800)

## Services Offered
- High-pressure scratch-free snow foam washing & detailing
- Industrial underbody pressure washing & heavy mud removal
- Multi-point computerized engine diagnostics & synthetic oil service
- Brake overhaul, clutch repair, and suspension servicing
- Car AC servicing & refrigerant gas top-up
- 24/7 highway breakdown, dead battery jumpstart & towing assistance
- Doorstep vehicle pickup & drop across Srikalahasti
